headline: ATL @ SDP matchup research

Batter research is strongest for Michael Harris II, Fernando Tatis Jr., Samad Taylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen, Jorge Mateo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
